title: Sweet 'n' Spicy Tofu Stir-Fry with Pineapple, Bell Pepper & Rice

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

While the rice is cooking, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a small bowl along with stir-fry sauce, hot sauce, and honey. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the pineapple.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pineapple and bell pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until bell pepper is starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Crumble the tofu with your fingers into the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is warmed through, about 2 minutes.
Add the sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls, then sprinkle with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
